cart.title: Check my documents
cart.onDevice: Photos are read on this phone and never uploaded.

cart.useAsBlocked: The {{doc}} slot already has a document. Remove it first to move this one.

confirm.title: Is this right?
confirm.intro: Please check each line against your document and fix anything wrong. Checks only run after you confirm.
confirm.readHint: Read from your photo. Please check.
confirm.missingHint: Not read. Please type it in, or leave it blank if it isn't on the document.
confirm.aadhaarNote: We keep only the last 4 digits of your Aadhaar number.
confirm.invalidDate: Please write the date as DD/MM/YYYY, or just the year.

cart.confirmFirst: Confirm or remove each document you added before checking.
cart.addOne: Add and confirm at least one document to check.

result.title: Your result
result.not_ready_sub: We found something in the documents you confirmed that commonly causes problems. Fixing it first may save you a trip.
result.almost_ready_sub: A few things are worth checking before you book.
result.ready_sub: We didn't find a problem in what you confirmed. Other requirements are not checked here.
result.disclaimer: This is a helper, not an official decision. Passport Seva decides what is accepted, and a good result here is not a guarantee of approval.
result.noIssues: No differences found between your confirmed documents.
result.provisional: We have not yet confirmed this rule against the official Passport Seva page. Please verify it there.
result.fixHint: Opens the chat with a short note about these issues, with no document details. Nothing is sent until you press send.

name_mismatch.found: The name on your {{a}} and your {{b}} look different.
name_mismatch.why: Names that differ between documents commonly cause problems and may need to be corrected.
name_mismatch.fix: Check that both were read correctly above. If both are right, ask Mitra how to fix a name difference.

name_spelling.found: The spelling of your name looks slightly different on your {{a}} and your {{b}}.
name_spelling.why: Small spelling differences commonly cause problems at verification.
name_spelling.fix: Check each document above. If they really differ, ask Mitra whether a correction is needed.

name_order.found: Your name is in a different order on your {{a}} and your {{b}}.
name_order.why: A different order of the same names can commonly cause problems at verification.
name_order.fix: Check the order on each document. If it differs, ask Mitra whether you need to correct it.

name_initials.found: Your {{a}} and your {{b}} seem to use initials or a shorter form of your name.
name_initials.why: Initials on one document and full names on another commonly cause problems.
name_initials.fix: Check how each document writes your name. If they differ, ask Mitra what to do.

dob_mismatch.found: The date of birth on your {{a}} and your {{b}} is different.
dob_mismatch.why: A date of birth that differs between documents commonly causes problems and may need to be corrected.
dob_mismatch.fix: Check that both were read correctly above. If both are right, ask Mitra how to correct a date of birth.

dob_proof_missing.found: We didn't see a document that proves your date of birth, such as a birth certificate or school certificate.
dob_proof_missing.why: Passport Seva asks for a proof of date of birth. Which documents are accepted can depend on your situation, so please verify.
dob_proof_missing.fix: Add one of these documents, or check the official list of accepted proofs.

dob_proof_birth_only.found: Your date of birth looks to be on or after 1 October 2023, and we didn't see a birth certificate.
dob_proof_birth_only.why: For that period the birth certificate is reported to be the listed proof of date of birth. Please verify this on the official page.
dob_proof_birth_only.fix: Add the birth certificate, or check the official list of accepted proofs.

minor_flow_required.found: Your date of birth suggests the applicant is under 18, but you chose a different application type.
minor_flow_required.why: Applications for people under 18 commonly follow a separate process. Please verify with Passport Seva.
minor_flow_required.fix: Change the application type above to "Child under 18", or check the date of birth you confirmed.

missing_address.found: We didn't see a proof of your present address.
missing_address.why: A proof of present address is normally asked for. Please verify what applies to you.
missing_address.fix: Add a rent agreement or utility bill, or check the official list of accepted address proofs.

missing_passport.found: We didn't see your old passport.
missing_passport.why: Re-issue normally needs the old passport. Please verify what applies to you.
missing_passport.fix: Add your old passport, or check the official re-issue document list.

address_mismatch.found: The address on your {{a}} and your {{b}} looks different.
address_mismatch.why: Addresses that differ between documents can commonly cause questions.
address_mismatch.fix: Check that both were read correctly above. If you have moved, ask Mitra which address proof to use.

parent_name_mismatch.found: A parent's name on your {{a}} and your {{b}} looks different.
parent_name_mismatch.why: Parents' names that differ between documents can commonly cause questions.
parent_name_mismatch.fix: Check that both were read correctly above. If both are right, ask Mitra what to do.

passport_expired.found: The expiry date on your old passport has passed.
passport_expired.why: This is common when you are renewing. We show it so you know the date was read.
passport_expired.fix: Nothing to fix for most re-issue applications. Carry the old passport.

notes.nameNotCompared: We could not compare the name on your {{doc}} because it is not written in English letters.
notes.dobNotCompared: We could not compare the date of birth on your {{doc}} because it is not a full date or a year.
notes.expiryNotCompared: We could not read a full expiry date for your old passport.
notes.ageUnknown: We could not work out the applicant's age, so the under-18 check was skipped.
notes.minorButAdult: You chose "Child under 18", but the date of birth you confirmed is 18 or older.
notes.singleDoc: Only one document was confirmed, so there is nothing to compare it with yet.
notes.reissueDobProof: For re-issue we do not check for a proof of date of birth.
notes.reissueAddress: For re-issue, a new address proof may be needed only if your address has changed. We do not check this.
notes.minorExtras: For a child, parents' consent forms and a parent's address proof may apply. We do not check these.
notes.otherRequirements: Photographs, forms, fees and other requirements are not checked here.

handoff.intro: My documents may have some problems.
handoff.general: I need help understanding which documents apply to my application.
handoff.name_mismatch: My name may not match between my {{a}} and my {{b}}.
handoff.name_order: My name may be in a different order on my {{a}} and my {{b}}.
handoff.name_initials: My name may use initials on my {{a}} or my {{b}}.
handoff.dob_mismatch: My date of birth differs between my {{a}} and my {{b}}.
handoff.address_mismatch: My address may differ between my {{a}} and my {{b}}.
handoff.parent_name_mismatch: A parent's name may differ between my {{a}} and my {{b}}.
handoff.dob_proof_missing: I am not sure which document proves my date of birth.
handoff.passport_expired: My old passport may have expired.
handoff.minor_flow_required: I may need the process for applicants under 18.

evisa.title: Visiting India? e-Visa pre-check
evisa.intro: For people who are not Indian citizens. Your answers stay on this page and are never sent anywhere.

fields.blankPages: Blank pages left in your passport
fields.arrival: Date you plan to arrive in India
fields.evisasThisYear: e-Visas you already used in that calendar year

origin.hint: Check the official definition on the e-Visa portal if you are unsure.

evisa.required: Please fill in your passport expiry date, blank pages and arrival date.

result.not_ready_sub: We found something that commonly causes problems with an e-Visa application.
result.almost_ready_sub: A few things are worth checking before you apply.
result.ready_sub: We did not find a problem in what you told us. Other requirements are not checked here.
result.disclaimer: This is a helper that uses rules from Indian mission pages. Rules can change and pages disagree. Confirm on the official portal before you pay or travel. A good result is not a guarantee that a visa will be granted.
result.noIssues: Nothing to fix in what you entered.
result.provisional: Sources disagree on this rule. Please confirm it on the official portal.

ineligible_passport.found: Your passport type is not one the e-Visa is listed for.
ineligible_passport.why: Diplomatic or official passports, travel documents and endorsements on another person's passport are listed as not eligible for the e-Visa.
ineligible_passport.fix: Ask the Indian mission in your country which visa applies to you.

pakistani_origin.found: You said you are of Pakistani origin.
pakistani_origin.why: People of Pakistani origin are listed as needing a regular visa from an Indian mission instead of the e-Visa.
pakistani_origin.fix: Apply for a regular visa at an Indian mission, and check the official definition first.

too_late.found: Your arrival date is less than {{days}} days away, or has already passed.
too_late.why: The e-Visa is listed as needing an application at least {{days}} days before you arrive.
too_late.fix: Move your arrival date later, or ask an Indian mission about other options.

too_early.found: Your arrival date is more than {{days}} days away.
too_early.why: Pages disagree on how early you can apply (30, 60, 120 or 180 days). We use {{days}} days as a default.
too_early.fix: Check the current window on the official portal before you apply.

passport_validity.found: Your passport may expire less than {{months}} months after you arrive.
passport_validity.why: The passport is listed as needing at least {{months}} months of validity from the day you arrive.
passport_validity.fix: Renew your passport first, or choose a date that leaves enough validity.

blank_pages.found: Your passport has fewer than {{pages}} blank pages.
blank_pages.why: At least {{pages}} blank pages are listed as needed.
blank_pages.fix: Get your passport updated or replaced before you apply.

yearly_limit.found: You have already used {{max}} or more e-Visas this calendar year.
yearly_limit.why: Up to {{max}} e-Visas per calendar year are stated on several mission pages.
yearly_limit.fix: Apply for a regular visa at an Indian mission, or check the official portal.

input_missing_arrival.found: We do not have a valid arrival date.
input_missing_arrival.fix: Enter the date you plan to arrive.

input_missing_expiry.found: We do not have a valid passport expiry date.
input_missing_expiry.fix: Enter the expiry date printed in your passport.

input_missing_blank_pages.found: We do not have the number of blank pages.
input_missing_blank_pages.fix: Count the blank pages in your passport and enter the number.

notes.originUnsure: You were not sure about Pakistani origin. Please check the official definition before you apply.
notes.yearlyUnknown: We did not check how many e-Visas you used this year.
notes.windowsVary: Mission pages disagree on how early you can apply (30 to 180 days). Please confirm the current window.
notes.onArrival: On arrival, biometrics are taken at immigration. Carry a Yellow Fever card if you arrive from an affected country.
notes.samePassport: Travel on the same passport you applied with. If the visa was granted on an older passport, carry that one too.
notes.confirmOfficial: Confirm every rule on the official portal. Rules can change.
